{{Otheruses|drift}}
{{Quote|What in the name of the Galactic Drift do you mean?|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], to [[Vuffi Raa]]|<ref name="MoS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
The '''galactic drift''', also known as '''interstellar drift''' or '''stellar drift''', was the movement of [[Star/Legends|stars]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It affected [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel.
